title: China Just Built What ASML Feared Most
author: K
text:
Daniel Nenni
Founder
Staff member

In this video, we break down how ASML became the only company on Earth capable of building the machines used to print the world’s most advanced chips, and why its power depends on one incredibly difficult part: the EUV light source. You’ll learn how ASML’s current system uses molten tin droplets, high-power lasers, plasma hotter than the surface of the sun, ultra-precise mirrors, and extreme ultraviolet light at 13.5 nanometers to manufacture cutting-edge semiconductors.

We also explain the Tsinghua University-led steady-state microbunching breakthrough, how electron storage rings could generate EUV light without tin droplets, why this approach could avoid ASML’s dirtiest and most expensive bottleneck, and why researchers in China, Germany, and the United States are now chasing particle-accelerator-based chipmaking.This is not a claim that China has already cloned ASML or built a full EUV chip factory. It is a story about a new physics pathway that could threaten the monopoly behind advanced lithography, reshape export controls, and change the future of semiconductor manufacturing.
